steps.t: Play Gone Fishing, then finish Chapter 1 (Paradise Lost) — story trophies pop on their own.
After Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house — the only possibly missable step in the game.
Turn on HUD notifications for the Criminal Profile so every action is tracked.
Out-fish Cal after Feng Shui: read the Fishing Magazine in Jason's shed, then beat Cal's challenge.
Do Kirk's Skunk Ape nights (Search for the Skunk Ape, NIGHT ONLY) and Shirley's Chapter 1 errands (Get Shirley's Rum, Steal the Scooter) before they expire.
Scan every vehicle and animal you pass with WAiNK and the binoculars — 200 vehicles and 100 animals are needed later.
Meet Bret in Veteran Hunted (Chapter 2, Jason only, near Mount Kalaga) and start his 15 Target Decks.
Meet Billy at the Mud Club (Thrillbillies, Chapter 2) and Andy in Belville (Chapter 3, Lucia only).
In Chapter 3, meet Tyrone in Here, Kitty Kitty (Jason) and race Yago the moment Race Against Yago appears — it is time-sensitive.
Run the Cartel Heist (Sinfrontera National Bank) to close Chapter 3 and pop Break the Bank.
Win a Top Fun drone race at every location you pass and land stunts as you drive — 250 stunts and 14 drone wins stack up naturally.
Rob shops with your partner (Retail Therapy) and lose a 4-star Wanted Level together (Hot Together) while the story keeps you paired.
Play the VCIA Takedown chain (Making Gainz to the airport heist) in Chapter 4 to pop Hi-Jacked.
Rescue Rafa in Child's Play (Family Matters) and work the Headliners launch party (DWNFALL) in Chapter 4.
Do That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4 — it unlocks the 8 bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal.
Gold the shooting ranges: Griffin in northwestern Vice City (18 golds) and Rodgers Ranch northeast of Port Gellhorn (24 golds), $5 Waiver Pass each.
Finish the story with Operation Savage Glory (Snow Storm) and The End of the Road — free-roam opens and the 100% checklist unlocks.
Rob 5 bank vaults (Maximum Withdrawal) now that all 8 are unlocked.
Steal the three valuables at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley (Let's Go Bowling).
Try the Ten Pin melee drive-by and the Capital Offense showroom escape — both are still disputed, so treat them as open, not solved.
Sweep the three unconfirmed trophies (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess) only if a second source confirms them.
Work the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion): 100 optional tasks, all robberies, 15/18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 70/80 challenges.
Finish the last Stranger strands and the last meditations (Ascent Mountain on Mount Kalaga).
When A Long Road pops, Vice Got a Price! follows at once — the Platinum is yours.
